What is the difference between Level 1 and Level 2 inputs in the IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy?
answers: Level 1 inputs are unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities; Level 2 inputs are inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1 that are observable either directly or indirectly
Level 1: quoted prices in active markets; Level 2: other observable inputs

q: Under IFRS 13, when fair value is determined using a valuation technique, the objective is to estimate the price at which an orderly transaction would take place between market participants at the measurement date. This requires maximising the use of relevant ______ inputs and minimising unobservable inputs.

An entity uses a discounted cash flow model to fair value a CGU. Under IFRS 13, the discount rate should reflect assumptions consistent with those inherent in the cash flows and should exclude risks for which cash flows have been adjusted. This is the principle of:
o: Consistency of assumptions between cash flows and discount rates
Risk maximisation in valuation
Conservative valuation
Historical rate application

q: IFRS 13 requires disclosure of a reconciliation of Level 3 fair value measurements from the opening balances to the closing balances, including total gains or losses recognised in profit or loss and OCI, purchases, sales, issues, settlements, and ______.
answers: transfers into or out of Level 3

q: Under IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting, interim financial reports must include a complete set of financial statements as required by IAS 1.

IAS 34 requires that the same accounting policies are applied in interim financial statements as in annual financial statements, except for accounting policy changes made after the most recent annual financial statements.
What is the treatment of income tax in interim financial statements under IAS 34?
answers: recognised based on the estimated weighted average annual effective income tax rate expected for the full financial year, applied to the pre-tax income of the interim period
using the estimated annual effective tax rate

o: Bonuses based on individual performance metrics disclosed separately by named individual
Short-term employee benefits

Share-based payments

Under IFRS 7, which of the following is a qualitative disclosure requirement regarding risks arising from financial instruments?

The exact carrying amount of each financial instrument
The name of each counterparty
The market price of each instrument at the reporting date
